turns.content: After erasing every 0 and 5 from the integers 1 through 2019, count the occurrences of each product-relevant digit, including the extra twenty thousands-place 2s from 2000 through 2019.
Using that deletion rule, verify the common multiplicity of the ordinary contributing digits and determine the extra thousands-place contribution from 2000 through 2019.
Use those multiplicities to write the product compactly, ignore neutral factors, and reduce the repeated common base modulo 1000.
For the modulo-125 branch, verify coprimality and state the applicable Euler exponent reduction.
Combine the two congruences by the Chinese remainder theorem and report the remainder modulo 1000.
